title: WPMS/622/2011 of M/S HIMALAYAN JIPSI ADVENTURE and OTHERS Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 622 of 2011
Hon'ble Tarun Agarwala, J.
Mr. Arvind Vashistha, Advocate for the
petitioners.
Mr. H.M. Raturi, Standing Counsel for
the State.
Against the notice dated 18th March,
2011 by the letters 583 and 529 certain
demands towards the entertainment tax has
been raised alongwith a direction to file the
application for renewal of the licence in the
prescribed format. The petitioner, being
aggrieved by the demand, has filed the writ
petition contending that the demand for
entertainment tax can not be clubbed with the
application of the petitioner for renewal of its
licence. In my opinion, the petitioner should
file its appropriate objection before the
authority concerned who will decide the matter
accordingly as per the provisions of the U.P.
Entertainment and Betting Tax Act, 1979. The
writ petition is dismissed at this stage. It is
made clear that if objection is filed, the
authority concerned will decide the matter by a
reasoned and speaking order after giving an
opportunity of hearing to the petitioner.
 (Tarun Agarwala, J.)
